ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level dominance of low-intensity dark pixels (~85-90%) punctuated by high-intensity white point clusters and distal patches (~10-15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white patches at the fluke tips; dense distribution of small, circular high-contrast rings (rosettes) across the dark macro-surface of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge presents regular, low-amplitude serrations; right lobe trailing edge shows extreme irregular topography with a deep, macro-scale notch and jagged indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe shows a linear-to-slightly-convex sweep; right lobe exhibits a pronounced convex sweep towards the upright tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of circular white pixel clusters (barnacle scars) across the entirety of the visible dark-pigmented fluke area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions visible primarily on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular indentation/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive calcified barnacle colonization on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly textured, granular clusters of high-intensity pixels at the fluke margins consistent with heavy barnacle infestation.
